messages:
kelly (Finance): Heads-up: Channel partner BrightNode submitted a dispute. They say a recent pricing experiment we ran for reseller tier discounts auto-applied a promotional rate to legacy committed seats during a ramp-back window, causing an unexpected 20% partner credit on Mar bill. They estimate USD 7,200 over-credit. Need to verify and either reverse or issue offsetting settlement. @owen @mira
owen (Sales): Confirmed BrightNode activated the reseller promo under experiment EXP-PR-042 on 2026-03-01. Ramp-back was supposed to exclude committed legacy SKUs but looks like rule matched broadly. cc @jon.
mira (Partner Ops): I pulled rule logs. Promo rule had condition "if reseller_tag=brightnode and sku_family!=legacy*" but our SKU naming mismatch meant legacy SKUs didn't match pattern and got included. Oops. @billing-bot can you pull the promo-applied settlement rows for BrightNode Mar 1-10?
billing-bot: Query complete. Found 6 settlement lines where promo_rate=20% incorrectly applied to sku ids LN-legacy-*. Duplicate partner credit total = USD 7,200. Created ticket FIN-3899. Raw CSV uploaded: https://redwood.internal/drive/brightnode-exp-pr-042.csv
kelly (Finance): Thanks. Two options: 1) Reverse the credit via settlement adjustment (debit partner ledger) 2) Let partner keep credit and treat as one-off marketing concession. Partner preference?
owen (Sales): BrightNode prefers reversal; they want books clean for their month-end. They can re-request if needed.
jon (RevOps): Operationally we can issue a settlement offset to BrightNode and then patch the promo rule for future runs. Need approval from Finance Lead to post reversal and GL treatment. Also need partner-signed waiver if we plan to debit them.
mira (Partner Ops): Sent partner note asking them to confirm acceptance of reversal. Link to email: https://redwood.internal/drive/brightnode-reversal-request.
kelly (Finance): Draft reversal memo (to be issued as settlement adj):

``
Settlement adjustment to BrightNode (partner id BN-11)
Amount: USD 7,200 (debit)
Reason: Erroneous partner credit applied due to promo rule pattern mismatch during EXP-PR-042 (2026-03-01 to 2026-03-10).
Related internal ticket: FIN-3899
GL code: 4220 (Partner settlements adjustments - recoveries)
``

Approvers: @isabel (Finance Lead).
isabel (Finance Lead): Approve conditional on partner confirmation. If partner declines reversal, we will document as one-off concession and expense to GL 5125. Please attach partner reply before routing to marketplace ops.
billing-bot: FIN-3899 updated: awaiting partner confirmation. If partner approves reversal, system will post provisional contra and route to AWS/GCP/Azure depending on marketplace.
kelly (Finance): Noted. I'll wait for partner confirmation and mark as "pending reversal" in month-close workbook. Will also schedule a postmortem to fix the promo pattern matching.
mir a (Partner Ops): (typo fixed) Partner replied: "BrightNode confirms and authorizes reversal to correct billing." Attached signed note: https://redwood.internal/drive/brightnode-signed-reversal.pdf
jon (RevOps): With partner sign-off, posting reversal now as provisional entry and queuing settlement request. billing-bot, please send to AWS settlement ops with expedited flag and attach FIN-3899 + signed reversal.
billing-bot: Settlement reversal submitted: AWS-SETTLE-9255. ETA 3-5 business days. Provisional journal JNL-4451 posted. FIN-3899 linked.
kelly (Finance): Posted adjustment in close workbook; flagged as "reversal approved by partner". Also adding note to experiment runbook to avoid SKU pattern pitfalls. Thanks all.
mira (Partner Ops): :thumbsup: Notifying partner that reversal is in process and sharing expected timeline.
